name: ⚽ Soccer Jam
description: The classic CS 1.6 Soccer Jam is back! First person with your knife, Red vs Blue on the dirty old soccerjam pitch. Charge power kicks and CURVE the ball, KNIFE the ball carrier to knock it loose, STAB from behind for a backstab knockout, build POWERPLAYS with passes, LONG JUMP and call for the ball. Alien mascots guard the goals. Cartoon knockouts, no blood. Earn EXP and buy upgrades: Stamina, Strength, Agility, Dexterity and Disarm. Bots fill the teams so you can play right away.
